title: The price of homogeneity is polynomial
summary: We provide explicit and polynomial bounds for the Homogeneous Wall Lemma which occurred for the first time implicitly in the $13$th entry of Robertson and Seymour's Graph Minors Series [JCTB 1990] and has since become a cornerstone in the algorithmic theory of graph minors. A wall where each brick is assigned a set of colours is said to be homogeneous if each brick is assigned the same set of colours.
